content.title: Review the default top holdings table
content.test_md_blob:
# Review the default top holdings table

> Prove the holdings card presents the expected eight holdings rows and the required table columns on the dashboard.

## Step 1

Open {{dashboard_url}} and wait until the dashboard page with the Top Holdings card is fully visible.

## Step 2

On the dashboard's Top Holdings card, inspect the visible table without opening any security overlays.

## Step 3

Assert that the Top Holdings table shows exactly eight rows.

## Step 4

Assert that the rows include AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, JPM, and XOM.

## Step 5

Assert that the column headers are ASSET, PRICE, DAY, POSITION, WEIGHT, and P&L.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-67, ac-68, ac-69

Confirm count check: 8 (equals) — the stated promise: The holdings table shows exactly eight holdings rows.
